summary: User repeating request after unhelpful AI response
detailed_context: User asked to 'implement' and received 'No response requested'—an unhelpful, confusing response. Now repeating the same terse command. This is a frustrated redirect: the user wanted action but got blocked. The single-word repetition signals they've lost patience with unclear communication. AI should have either clarified what to implement or begun implementation work. Terse + repeated = dissatisfaction.
